'''Sarkh''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] serving in the [[Trandoshan pirates|Trandoshan Pirates]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] defeated his [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dheeb]] and his peer, [[Grahssk]] at the [[Trandoshan Pirate's outpost]].
